12.2 Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: The client can end the contract immediately without notice and without paying for work done, while you have no equivalent right.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon providing 20 days prior written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: 6.1 All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work transfers to the client upon delivery before you have received payment, which removes your leverage if payment is delayed.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few changes before signing:

- In the relevant clause regarding termination, the agreement currently permits ending the contract immediately without notice and without payment; I propose modifying this so that either party may terminate this Agreement upon providing 20 days prior written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination.
- Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, ownership currently transfers upon delivery before payment is received; I propose that all intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable.

Best regards
